title: 42nd sitting of the 20th Majlis

items.text: Opening recitation (Hamd and Salawat); the sitting begins.
Roll call of members present at the sitting.
Announcement of the day's agenda (Agenda No. އޖ/42/2024).
Preliminary debate on the Bill amending the Anti-Corruption Commission Act (Law No. 13/2008), submitted on behalf of the government by Felidhoo MP Adam Zahir.
Government Oversight Committee report on granting parliamentary consent to three ministers appointed to the Cabinet by the President under Article 129(a) of the Constitution.
Foreign Relations Committee report on the President's nominee for Ambassador of the Maldives to the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia.
Budget Committee report on the proposed Supplementary Budget for 2024.
Voting on items from the day's business that have reached the voting stage.

summary: The sitting began debate on the Anti-Corruption Commission Act amendment and took up committee reports on three new ministers, the ambassador to Saudi Arabia and the 2024 supplementary budget.
